policy: Do not modify Luca lemma IDs or existing italian-core entries. Flag homographs for Phase 12C authors. Sentence lemmas[] are author-assigned, so collisions are authoring hazards, not automatic tokenizer bugs.

reuseExistingDoNotDuplicate.risk: Also verb dare inflection. Keep lemma da only as preposition.
Do not add a second parte for 'leave' / da parte. Avoid the phrase in A1 Elena if unclear.

reuseExistingDoNotDuplicate.existing: noun: time / weather (Luca ch12 used as time pressure)
reuseExistingDoNotDuplicate.risk: Elena ch11 must teach weather sense (che tempo fa + sole/pioggia). Same lemmaId.

reuseExistingDoNotDuplicate.existing: adverb: now (Luca ch17). Notes already say it can mean hour.
reuseExistingDoNotDuplicate.risk: Clock questions should use new lemma ore, not overload ora.
Do not use piano for 'slowly' in Elena A1.

reuseExistingDoNotDuplicate.existing: adverb: how much (unused in Luca A1; introducedChapter 26)
reuseExistingDoNotDuplicate.risk: Map quanti/quante to quanto. Do not create lemma quanti.
Number 'one' reuses uno. Do not add lemma uno_num.
Do not add papà under a new id. Do not confuse with Papa (pope).
Do not add via in 12B. via is street vs away/preposition — defer.

newLemmasWithHomographNotes.clash: essere 2sg inflection 'sei' already listed under essere
newLemmasWithHomographNotes.authoring: For 'Sei stanca?' use lemma essere. For 'Ho sei mele' use lemma sei.

newLemmasWithHomographNotes.clash: adjective solo/sola 'alone' is different; sole can also be feminine 'alone' in some forms
newLemmasWithHomographNotes.authoring: Use only as weather noun: c'è il sole.
A1 only in stare male / va male. Do not teach il male.
Prices only: è caro. Not caro Stefano.
After trattoria: un dolce. Keep as noun in 12C.
Castelbianco is un paese. Do not use for 'Italy the country' in A1.

newLemmasWithHomographNotes.clash: English camera; Italian macchina fotografica is photo camera

newLemmasWithHomographNotes.authoring: Trattoria only. Prefer voglio / prendo if unclear.

newLemmasWithHomographNotes.clash: past participle of aprire (Luca has aprire)
newLemmasWithHomographNotes.authoring: May map to aprire in some sentences. Prefer lemma aperto when used as adjective: il negozio è aperto.

newLemmasWithHomographNotes.clash: past participle of chiudere (Luca has chiudere)
newLemmasWithHomographNotes.authoring: Same as aperto: adjective vs participle. Shop sign sense uses chiuso.

doNotAddIn12B.reason: Street vs preposition away. Use strada / via-paese location name only.
Conditional. Prefer voglio + per_favore. Do not add or teach a paradigm.
